acceptance: Artifact writes bind content hash, provenance, version, tenant classification and atomic manifest visibility.

positive.fixture: round trip, signed manifest binding artifact digests, sizes, classes, provenance and tenant, whole-manifest visibility, public sharing and private separation

negative.fixture: tampered, forged, revoked-key and moved manifests refused; torn and half-built writes never visible; bit rot and lost objects detected not served; backends refuse overwrite with different bytes

versions.primitive: Manifest schema vsf.manifest v1 (Ed25519 over canonical JSON); separate from the Rust-verified IR version promotion.

security_and_source_permissions: A manifest is readable only for the tenant named in its signed document.
performance_memory_storage: Not measured at this task; see T03.
known_limitations: Signing keys are supplied by the caller; key custody belongs to B14
